blurb: A sweeping valley road, one jump over the stream, then dirt for the final stretch.
Zigzag through the woods in the rally car, then the stadium car takes the lakeshore.
Switchbacks up the mountain, the rally car down the dirt, and a flat-out run home.
Fast forest dirt with jumps, then the stadium car for the loop and the wall.
The big one: tarmac, forest dirt and a beach run, three cars in one lap.
A short, snappy dirt trail through the red woods, then tarmac for the last sprint.
Farm tracks and sandy fields: rally car, desert car, rally car again.
A narrow walled gorge for the stadium car, then out onto the rally trail.
Down the mountain in switchbacks, across a tarmac viaduct, and down again.
Autumn forest, a tarmac mountain road and the first snow of winter. Three cars.
A quick run over fresh powder, then the rally car for the dirt road home.
Glide across the ice in the snow car, then switch to the stadium car on the gritted road.
Downhill at full speed, then the snow car down the chute, and the stadium car for the runout.
Narrow ice canyons, a rally dirt shortcut under the glacier, and back onto the ice.
The longest road in the snow: stadium, snow and rally cars across the whole range.
Fly over the dunes, then pull on the stadium car for the walls at the end.
Sand, then the rally car through the dirt canyon, then back to the dunes.
Rally car over the rocky ridge, then the desert car for four big jumps.
A tarmac highway, a dune shortcut through the oasis, and a high-speed finish.
The longest drive in the desert: sand, dirt and tarmac, and home across the dunes.
A flat-out lap under the floodlights: loop, wall, then a dirt alley to the line.
Slide through the back alleys in the rally car, then stadium speed down the main drag.
Spirals, loops and wall rides above the city, with a sandy rooftop in the middle.
Snow and ice up the peak, tarmac across the ridge, and back down on the snow.
Every car, every trick: stadium, rally, snow and desert in one run under the lights.
